description: Contact Form & Support System (E1-S12) - Implement comprehensive contact form and support ticket system for prospects, guests, and admins

userStories.title: Prisma Schema Updates for Support System
userStories.description: Enhance SupportTicket model and add required enums for the support system
acceptanceCriteria: Add TicketCategory enum with values: GENERAL_INQUIRY, BOOKING_QUESTION, MEDICAL_WELLNESS_QUESTION, PAYMENT_ISSUE, PARTNERSHIP_INQUIRY, OTHER
Add TicketSource enum with values: WEBSITE_CONTACT, GUEST_DASHBOARD, ADMIN_CREATED, EMAIL

Enhance SupportTicket model with: category (TicketCategory), source (TicketSource), email (String), name (String?), phone (String?), bookingId (String?), assignedToId (String?), resolvedAt (DateTime?), referenceNumber (String unique)
Add SupportTicketReply model for admin/guest replies with: id, ticketId, userId, message, isAdminReply, createdAt
Add SupportTicketAttachment model for file uploads with: id, ticketId, fileName, fileUrl, fileSize, mimeType, createdAt
Add relation from SupportTicket to User for assignedTo field
Add relation from SupportTicket to Booking (optional)
Run prisma db push successfully with no errors
Generate Prisma client with no TypeScript errors
userStories.notes: This story must be completed first as all other stories depend on the enhanced schema. Use prisma db push for development. Reference existing enum patterns in schema.prisma.

userStories.title: Public Contact Form
userStories.description: Prospects can submit inquiries from marketing site without authentication
acceptanceCriteria: Form appears on `/contact` route (public, no auth required)
Fields: Name, Email, Phone (optional), Category (dropdown with TicketCategory values), Message, Trip Interest (dropdown), Timeline (dropdown)
Form validation: Email required, message min 20 chars, phone format validation if provided
Submit button shows loading state, success message after submission
Form submission creates SupportTicket with status=OPEN, source=WEBSITE_CONTACT
Reference number generated and displayed to user on success
Honeypot field for spam prevention (hidden field that bots fill)
Responsive design (Tailwind), accessible (ARIA labels, semantic HTML)
TypeScript strict mode: 0 errors
userStories.notes: Use tRPC mutation: support.createPublicTicket. Generate reference number as 'TKT-' + nanoid(8). Store IP address for duplicate detection.

userStories.title: Guest Support Form in Dashboard
userStories.description: Authenticated guests can submit support requests tied to their bookings
acceptanceCriteria: New `/dashboard/support` page accessible to guests
Form fields: Category (dropdown), Message, Priority (Normal/Urgent)
Ticket auto-links to guest's current/latest booking (if available)
Form submission shows confirmation toast with reference number
Guests can see their tickets in dashboard (readonly list with status badges)
Click on ticket shows detail view with replies
TypeScript strict mode: 0 errors
userStories.notes: Use tRPC mutation: support.createGuestTicket. Auto-populate email and name from session. Reuse existing UI components for consistency.

userStories.title: Support Ticket Admin Dashboard
userStories.description: Admins can view, manage, and respond to all support tickets
acceptanceCriteria: New `/dashboard/admin/support` page (admin-only access)
Ticket list view with filters: Status, Priority, Source, Category, Date range
Ticket detail view shows: Full message, timeline of replies, guest info (if authenticated), status/priority badges
Reply form with textarea for admin responses
Inline actions: Mark In Progress, Resolve, Close
Assignment dropdown (assign to self or unassigned)
Search across ticket fields (name, email, message content, reference number)
TypeScript strict mode: 0 errors
userStories.notes: Use tRPC: support.getTickets, support.getTicketDetail, support.replyToTicket, support.updateTicketStatus. Implement optimistic updates for status changes.

userStories.title: Email Notification System
userStories.description: Automated emails notify stakeholders of ticket activity
acceptanceCriteria: Prospect/Guest receives confirmation email on ticket creation with reference number
Admin receives notification for new tickets
Admin receives immediate notification if Priority=URGENT
Guest receives notification when admin replies
Guest receives notification when ticket resolved
All emails include ticket reference number for tracking
All emails use existing SendGrid infrastructure
userStories.notes: Use existing email service patterns. Create email templates for: ticket-created, ticket-admin-notification, ticket-reply, ticket-resolved.

userStories.title: Public Ticket Status Page
userStories.description: Prospects can check ticket status without logging in
acceptanceCriteria: Route: `/support/status` with form to enter reference number and email
Verify email + reference number match before showing details
Display: Ticket subject/message, submitted date, status, admin replies (if any)
Link back to contact form if ticket closed
No auth required, fully public access
Rate limit to 10 lookups per email per hour (spam prevention)
TypeScript strict mode: 0 errors
userStories.notes: Use public procedure: support.getPublicTicketStatus. Validate email/referenceNumber combo in database.
